front.zh: 現代俳句 & 變奏   系列《16》

zh: 境內，風淡雲輕，花色溫馨
境外，一種凝定，一種清明
en: Within, the wind is faint, the clouds light, the flowers warmly colored
Beyond, a stillness, a clarity
The scenery one hoped for gradually unfolds

points.zh:
「 只需要前進一點，無限小的一點距離，人就會發現自己在邊境的另一端 。」
-- 米蘭 . 昆德拉  ( Milan Kundera )
points.en:
"One need only advance a little—an infinitely small distance—and a person will find himself on the other side of the border."
--Milan Kundera

zh: 飄落於，傘影晃動的巴黎
en: Late spring, there is rain
In the rain, the rain is a fine misting rain
Falling over a Paris where umbrella shadows sway
Bygone days, light as musical notes
The road ahead, vast and hazy
Only letting the evening wind blow
So beautiful, yet
So destructive
Pele, Magma, Aloha

points.zh:
Authorities ordered at least 1,700 residents to evacuate homes near Hawaii’s Kilauea volcano after its crater floor collapsed on April 30, 2018.  Magma flow into the lower East Rift Zone has resulted in several lava- and gas-releasing fissures near Pahoa. “If you`ve ever seen a flow move through an area, there is nothing that can stop it. Absolutely nothing.”     (Time Magazine, 5/21/2018 )
In the Hawaiian religion, Pele, the Fire Goddess, is the goddess of fire, lightning, wind and volcanoes and the creator of the Hawaiian Islands. According to legend, Pele lives in the crater Kīlauea. She is a well-known deity within Hawaiian mythology, and is notable for her contemporary presence and cultural influence as an enduring figure from ancient Hawaii.

en: Dusk, calm and still
The setting sun, about to fall yet not fallen, runs aground upon
The hesitation between splendor and retreat
Fine rain outside the window
Missing you who have gone
Remembering, you said there was no date for your return

points.zh:
君問歸期未有期，巴山夜雨漲秋池。
何當共剪西窗燭，卻話巴山夜雨時。
--唐 。李商隱《 夜雨寄北 》
points.en:
You ask when I will return, but no date is set; night rain in the Ba mountains swells the autumn pond.
When shall we together trim the candle by the west window, and speak of this hour of night rain in the Ba mountains?
-- Tang Dynasty. Li Shangyin, "Night Rain, Sent North" (夜雨寄北)

en: Bright spring light, the grass color low and hazy
Could one have imagined
A silent forest, a boundless snowfield
I take meeting you in this life
Left for the dusk
And then, let the moonlight set the scene
The years are like a tide, submerging
Footprints once walked
Will there be seashells up ahead?
An old wall stands silent
The mountain-falling wind is fickle
At dusk in Hengchun, old thoughts of longing rise

points.zh:
《 若是到恆春 》 宋澤萊
若是到恆春，著愛落雨的時陣
罩霧的山崙，親像姑娘的溫存
若是到恆春，愛揀黃昏的時陣
海墘的晚雲，半天通紅像抹粉
若是到恆春，著愛好天的時陣
出帆的海船，有時駛遠有時近
若是到恆春，嘸免揀時陣
陳達的歌若唱起，一時消阮的心悶
宋澤萊的《若是到恆春》一詩，寫於1981年，是早期台語文學運動中的重要作品。此詩傳頌很廣，和這首詩的押韻有關。除了第十五行外，全詩一韻到底，句句押韻，讓整首詩朗誦起來有如歌謠。用台語朗讀，更能體會音韻的美好，而與恆春的美景相呼應。宋澤萊主要著作 : 小說系列《打牛湳村》，《廢墟台灣》; 評論《文學十日談》，《給台灣文學界的七封信》; 詩集《福爾摩莎頌歌》; 創辦《臺灣新文化》，《臺灣新文學》，《臺灣ｅ文藝》等雜誌。
陳達（1906－1981，臺灣屏東恆春人），是國寳級民謠歌手。他以融合彈奏月琴和故事敘說，並具個人特色的演出著稱。由於他的歌聲蒼涼，歌詞有詩境，搭配月琴清唱，再加上其情感十分豐沛，廣受歡迎，其中最有名的歌曲，就是《 思想起 》。
落山風是恆春半島特有的天氣現象。 落山風的成因是每年的十月至第二年的四月間，東北季風沿著中央山脈3000公尺的高山由北向南流動，愈往南山脈高度愈低，到了恆春半島大武山區附近高度已降為1000公尺至400公尺以下，因此形成強大的氣流翻過山脈而下的坡風，這就是所謂的「落山風」。落山風瞬間強度可達6、7級，相當於輕度颱風的威力。  有時可持續數天之久。
points.en:
"If You Come to Hengchun," by Song Tse-lai
If you come to Hengchun, best when it is raining
the mist-covered hills are like a young woman's tenderness
If you come to Hengchun, best at dusk
the evening clouds by the sea glow red across half the sky, like rouge
If you come to Hengchun, best on a clear day
the fishing boats setting sail, sometimes far, sometimes near
If you come to Hengchun, there is no need to choose the time
once Chen Ta's song begins to play, it dissolves my sorrow at once
Song Tse-lai's poem "If You Come to Hengchun" was written in 1981 and is an important work of the early Taiwanese-language literature movement. It has been widely recited, partly because of its rhyme scheme: apart from the fifteenth line, the entire poem keeps a single rhyme throughout, with every line rhyming, so that reciting it feels like singing a folk song. Reading it aloud in Taiwanese brings out the beauty of its sound even more, echoing the beautiful scenery of Hengchun. Song Tse-lai's major works include the novel series "Dahuinan Village" and "Ruins of Taiwan"; the essay collections "Ten Nights of Talk on Literature" and "Seven Letters to the Taiwanese Literary World"; the poetry collection "Ode to Formosa"; and he founded magazines such as "Taiwan New Culture," "Taiwan New Literature," and "Taiwan E Literature and Art."
Chen Ta (1906-1981), a native of Hengchun, Pingtung, Taiwan, was a folk singer regarded as a national treasure. He was known for performances that combined playing the moon lute (yueqin) with storytelling in a distinctive personal style. His singing voice was desolate and moving, his lyrics had a poetic quality, and combined with the unaccompanied melodies of the moon lute and his abundant emotion, he was widely beloved; his most famous song was "Thoughts Arise" (Su-siong-khi).
The "mountain-descending wind" (luoshanfeng) is a weather phenomenon unique to the Hengchun Peninsula. It occurs because, from October through April of the following year, the northeast monsoon flows from north to south along the 3,000-meter peaks of the Central Mountain Range; the range grows progressively lower toward the south, and by the time it reaches the Dawu Mountain area of the Hengchun Peninsula, its height has dropped to below 1,000 to 400 meters. This produces a powerful downslope wind pouring over the mountains, known as the "mountain-descending wind." Its instantaneous intensity can reach force 6 or 7, comparable to a mild typhoon, and it can sometimes last for several days.
